evidence: A/list-01.png: overdue SLA shown as red text plus warning icon and a red row edge, single-line tabular timestamps; titles wrap in a narrow column
A/detail-01.png: trend chart has a 55 °C threshold line and a value table below, with readings above the limit in red
B/list-01.png: overdue SLA as a filled red badge with icon and '已超时 12分' plus a 响应时限 label, and '选择全部 1,286 项' in the bulk bar
B/detail-01.png: chart title states '2 小时内升高 22.3 °C，仍在上升' and marks '08:50 越过阈值'; SLA cards carry 达标/计时中 text labels
B/list-empty-01.png: empty state names the cause and offers a targeted '移除「负责人 = 王建国」' as well as clearing all filters

pairs.reason: B marks overdue SLA as filled icon-and-text badges and its detail chart states the rise and the 08:50 threshold crossing; A's overdue cues are quieter.

notes: Both have clean fact sheets (0 AA failures, 0 target failures) and never show status by colour alone. They are close. A is stronger in its one-line timestamps and the value table under its chart. B wraps timestamps onto two lines and has no data table, but its overdue signal and task-specific empty and error states are clearer for a supervisor who fears missing a P1.
